results.notes: Same unsaved wizard throughout (Brand analysis card + Continue): phase A Decathlon (decathlon.com), United Kingdom - English (EN), AI Insights English (EN), discovery returned Sporting Goods + Outdoor Gear, Outdoor Gear removed = 40 prompts (TC-006/007/008); phase B France - French (FR) added via the stepper, Outdoor Gear re-added as custom category (FR translation "Équipement d'extérieur") = 140 prompts (TC-001..005); phase C 5 more custom categories = 440 prompts vs 430 free slots (TC-009 attempt); then back to 2 categories, 140 prompts, 7 unticked (TC-010 creation). Back office read-only (Organisations > QA-GEO > Actions > View > Close; nothing edited): "Authorised AI Engine providers" ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, Claude, Perplexity. Review (minimal scope GB (EN), Sporting Goods, 40 prompts): 5 toggles, ChatGPT and Gemini on, Grok/Claude/Perplexity off (red frames in step3). No engine outside the allowed list, no "Available on higher plans" / Upgrade text (the "other engines not shown" part is weakly tested since all 5 engines are allowed for QA-GEO). Analysis: the story Technical Details say "If neither Gemini nor ChatGPT is allowed, every allowed engine starts on" (and TAC3), which implies the default set is ChatGPT + Gemini when they are allowed: the observed behaviour matches that rule, so this is most likely a TC/AC wording issue rather than a product bug. To confirm with the PO before any bug.
results.description: Verify that the engines allowed for the organisation in the back office are toggles, on by default, and that the other engines are not shown (no "Available on higher plans" or Upgrade block). Covers AC-3. Needs setup: read the allowed AI engines of organisation T in the back office.

results.notes: Same unsaved wizard throughout (Brand analysis card + Continue): phase A Decathlon (decathlon.com), United Kingdom - English (EN), AI Insights English (EN), discovery returned Sporting Goods + Outdoor Gear, Outdoor Gear removed = 40 prompts (TC-006/007/008); phase B France - French (FR) added via the stepper, Outdoor Gear re-added as custom category (FR translation "Équipement d'extérieur") = 140 prompts (TC-001..005); phase C 5 more custom categories = 440 prompts vs 430 free slots (TC-009 attempt); then back to 2 categories, 140 prompts, 7 unticked (TC-010 creation). Given: Grok, Claude, Perplexity switched on by hand = 5 on. Turned off Gemini, Grok, Claude, Perplexity: ChatGPT alone on, Create Analysis enabled.
